name: paper
description: Reach Paper Desktop from Cursor Cloud Agents through your local-mcp-gateway public HTTPS URL.

LMG_PAPER_MCP_URL.title: Paper MCP URL
LMG_PAPER_MCP_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL printed by `lmg serve` (…/paper/mcp).

LMG_API_KEY.title: Gateway API key
LMG_API_KEY.description: Same fixed Bearer token as LMG_API_KEY on the machine running `lmg serve`.
